label: Sync Gateway Dev Ops (Server RBAC role)
type: one of six fine-grained Server RBAC roles Couchbase Server 7.0.2 Developer Preview added specifically for Sync Gateway's Admin REST API. Manages Sync Gateway's node-level configuration and read access to its /metrics endpoint (the role Prometheus-adjacent tooling and the port:4985 Admin API surface's node-scoped endpoints reach for); does not grant Web Console login.
aliases_note: A1 (rest-api-access.json, rest-api-access-rbac-roles.json) minted this role already spelled to match its internal name; A2 (rest_api_admin.json) independently minted the shorter `role:sgw-dev-ops` for the identical role - folded as an alias.
evidence: Role: Sync Gateway Dev Ops (sync_gateway_dev_ops) ... The Sync Gateway Dev Ops role lets the user manage the Sync Gateway's node-level configuration. It also grants access to Sync Gateway's `/metrics` endpoint for Prometheus integration. This role does not let the user log into Couchbase Server Web Console.
note: Round 28 first contact with the 7.0.2+ fine-grained Sync-Gateway-RBAC catalogue extension. Named on rest-api-access-rbac-roles.md's cross-reference table as the sole 7.0.2-Developer-Preview role satisfying every cluster-scoped diagnostic/config endpoint (the {cluster}/_config, _debug/*, _logging, _sgcollect_info family) that pre-7.0.2 required Cluster Admin/Full Admin/Read Only Admin for.
